description: Mandated bindings (standards §18.2, §18.3): standing policy, separate from .architecture-exceptions.json. Each entry has an owner, a policy reference and an annual review date; entries do not expire. npm run check:bindings resolves every org-mandated binding per deployment target in the installed dependency tree and the built server, or for a browser script in the built client and the Content-Security-Policy, and fails on any mismatch.

bindings.policyReference: Hosted-Postgres profile (programming Project wiki, concepts/coding-standards-hosted-postgres): password hashing via the mandated argon2 binding; docs/standards/hosted-postgres-profile.md
Hosted-Postgres profile (programming Project wiki, concepts/coding-standards-hosted-postgres): Better Auth; ADR-0006, ADR-0008

bindings.capability: Apple Music authorization in the browser
bindings.policyReference: ADR-0005: MusicKit on the Web, loaded from Apple's CDN as Apple's documentation instructs, is how a browser obtains a Music User Token; docs/design/apple-music-import.md

targets.integrity: none: Apple serves MusicKit v3 from one unversioned address and publishes no integrity hash; the Content-Security-Policy limits scripts to this origin and this server
